slides.title: 20 things to do the night before an 8am
slides.aside: (so you're not waking up at 7:52. send it to the friend with the 8am)

slides.heading: before 11
items: pack the bag, by the door
keys + ID in the same spot

slides.heading: lights out
items: count back 8 hours from your alarm
phone charging away from the pillow
apps go to sleep at bedtime
glass of water by the bed
feet on the floor before the phone

slides.heading: how i actually do #14 and #19
slides.text:
my apps _go to sleep_ at bedtime and stay asleep until i've _walked 200 steps_

by the time instagram wakes up, i'm already up

*(the rest of the list is just habit)*
